question: What cause produces supreme satisfaction when the inner fusion is vehemently struck?
premises: An inner state is being struck.
This striking functions as a cause of supreme satisfaction.
inference: Vehement impact upon the inner fusion yields supreme satisfaction because that impact serves as its cause.
uncertainties: The exact subject undergoing the striking is implicit from the surrounding verses.
plain_english: When it is struck vehemently, this happens because it is the cause of supreme satisfaction.
